name: looksift
description: Use real Looksift style, palette, outfit, layout and facial-expression references for prompts and images with your Agent's image tool.

interface.longDescription: Choose a numbered style, palette, outfit or layout reference on Looksift and bring it to your Agent. Any one kind is enough. A selected style has two independent Qwen/GPT reference versions; outfit edits preserve the supplied person's identity and pose. A capable client generates images. Without drawing or the required reference-image inputs, the Agent delivers full prompts, real reference download links, input order and brief usage steps. The remote MCP provides the official prompt templates and public reference data; it needs no login and does not generate your final artwork. Responses follow your language and prompt-only never draws. Pose, action, monster and private collections are outside this version. Layout L-numbers provide composition and typography references in four languages. Adapt them to your own subject and exact quoted text; the reference does not fix your output aspect ratio. Describe an expression naturally, then adjust it in conversation. Natural, Pixar and anime are facial-expression parameter modes, not changes to the person or overall art style. Read the real parameters and exact-state neutral-head PNG; retain your original person as the identity source. Fine editing is available on the expression page.
defaultPrompt: How do I use Looksift? Show me where to choose style, palette, outfit or layout references.
Use Looksift style 47 for a seaside bookshop. Write only the prompts in my language; do not generate images.
Use Looksift to make the person in my image laugh naturally at 65%, keeping their identity and the existing art style.
